description: Fork of exp732 (4K short-horizon baseline, val=1.3912). Single change: v_input_nap 6 -> 7 (v_lut K 64 -> 128, +37.7M params -> 314.5M total). Tests whether v_lut benefits from a deeper input NAP at d_v=64. n_outputs=64 stays below the bmm-wgrad threshold (n_out>=128), so v_lut continues to use index_add wgrad. Expected wallclock ~85-90 min (vs exp732 73 min) due to wider K-wide chain in v_lut bwd. Everything else identical: 4K steps, bs=24 ga=2, Lion lr=2e-4 for LUT, AdamW 3e-4 non-LUT.
